title: Source observation record (snapshot form)
status: DRAFT - not authoritative until Bob ratifies it (task A0)
description: One public SatNOGS observation as stored in the immutable snapshot. Field names verified live on 2026-08-16 against network.satnogs.org; see docs/SATNOGS_API_RECON.md section 2.

ground_station.description: Station id. GROUPING KEY for cold-station splits.

center_frequency.description: MEASURED NULL ON EVERY RECORD INSPECTED. Do not depend on it. Use client_metadata.radio.parameters.rx-freq.

max_altitude.description: API-reported peak elevation. Used to VALIDATE our SGP4, not as a feature.

waterfall.description: Artifact URL on wasabisys, a separate failure domain from the API host.

waterfall_status.description: SILVER label. 'unknown' stays unlabelled. A null waterfall is artifact-unusable, NOT a negative.

client_family.description: Derived: client_version normalised. GROUPING KEY for format holdouts.

client_metadata.description: JSON-ENCODED STRING, not an object. Parse it. Holds rx-freq, samp-rate-rx, radio name/version, lo-offset, ppm.
